messages:
Alex: Holy cow team — we just hit 500k requests/day! :tada:
Sam: whoa that's huge. midweek glory! :raised_hands:
DevOps Bot: Metric alert — daily_requests = 500,214, peak_rps = 12.3, p95_latency_ms = 82. Congrats! :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jordan: I will bake sourdough for the office tomorrow. plant-toast optional. :bread: :herb:
Maria: I can bring coffee and tiny confetti poppers. photo contest: best shelfie wins a sticker pack. :coffee: :sparkles:
Priya: Love it. Zoom toast at 3pm PT? quick 5-min huddle to celebrate remote folks too. :clinking_glasses:
Ryan: I'll do a virtual gong from my desk — expect a terrible recording. :drum:
Alex: also huge props to infra for the autoscale tweak last night. saved us a ton of headroom. :heart: @DevOps Bot you single-handedly stopped a cascade 
DevOps Bot: noted. Posting a tiny diagnostics snippet for posterity:
```
requests_today: 500214
avg_rps: 6.8
peak_rps: 12.3
errors_5xx: 2
active_workers: 48
```
Jordan: drooling already. anyone allergic to sesame? asking for the bakery. :eyes:
Maria: no allergies on my end. i'll label things. also taking a shelfie pic later. :camera_with_flash:
Sam: can someone snap the sourdough close-up for the #foodies channel? :drooling_face:
Priya: RSVP for in-person folks: @Jordan, @Maria, @Alex, @Ryan. remote folks join the 3pm call! :calendar:
Alex: thanks everyone — tiny milestone, but feels big. feels like the product humming. well done. :tada: :rocket:
Ryan: GIF incoming <https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-500k|https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-500k>
Maria: confetti is ordered. also, shelfie challenge rules: bonus points for plant and mug combo. :seedling: :mug:
Jordan: will add a tiny handwritten note that says "500k" on the bread tag. ridiculous but iconic. :laughing:
Sam: love dumb traditions. see you all (virtually) at 3. :v:
